text: Planning is done. This is the first lesson where terraform apply actually builds something real.
Six resources go up: two versioned, private S3 buckets, the Kinesis stream at 2 shards, the Glue database, and a Redshift cluster with one empty schema inside it.
Creating that schema needs Terraform's one honest exception -- a single local-exec provisioner running one SQL statement, since there's no native resource for a Redshift schema.
terraform state list confirms exactly six resources, matching what was planned two lessons ago, resource for resource. No Lambda, no crawler, no Gold tables yet.
The foundation exists. Next: streaming real inverter telemetry through Kinesis and Lambda into S3.
